Custom decal stickers for CanSky Roofing with quality vinyl materials

Can-Sky Roofing is a local business that has been in the roofing business for over 30 years. They are based in Toronto and have been recognized by many of our area’s residents for their expertise and customer service.

They came to us at Vinyl Wrap Toronto looking to improve their visibility on the road and were looking for a way to put their logo, contact information, and more on their pickup truck. We were happy to help! Our team of graphic designers and installers have more than ten years of experience in their expertise, so any project we take on is sure to be done right.

The decals they ordered were applied to the side panels of their pickup truck using high-quality vinyl that will last for years to come—and they look great! This is just one more way that Can-Sky Roofing can help get their business noticed as they drive around town. If you’re looking for a way to get more customers and improve your business, our team of experts can help! We’ve helped many businesses in Toronto and surrounding areas with their graphic design, installation, and marketing needs. If you’re interested in getting started on your project today, call or email us.

If you would like to brand your car, truck, boat, or other personal items with custom decal stickers – as long as it fits into our garage and has a smooth surface, we would love to wrap it! For your inspiration or your next custom decal stickers and letterings with Vinyl Wrap Toronto, do not forget to check out our Portfolio.

Get a Free Quote today by filling out the form and our team will get back to you as soon as possible. You can reach us at 416-746-1381 or email us at info@vinylwraptoronto.com. You can also visit us at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4.
